# Capability matrix

Generated by `make skills-sync` from the capability parity page. Do not edit by hand.

Source of truth: [capability parity](https://example.test/acme/mono/blob/main/parity.md), whose Evidence column explains the path prefixes.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| done | A parity contract pins the SDK's behavior to Go |
| partial | The SDK ships a subset |
| unverified | A module exists but nothing pins it to Go |
| none | No module for the capability in the SDK tree |
| n/a | The capability is a language seam with no counterpart |
